0022600036.text: The Miami Heat, 5-6 and on a two-game winning streak, host the Cleveland Cavaliers, who are also 5-6 but have lost their last two, in a matchup that sees Miami at 1-3 at home and 4-3 on the road this season. Cleveland is without Sam Merrill, who is out with an elbow injury, and the Cavaliers have gone 1-4 away from home this season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with Cleveland winning the last meeting 149-128 in Cleveland on March 27, 2026.
